Description: Pseudonymous customer identifier. A customer can have multiple cases.
Case creation timestamp in ISO format.
Geographical region of the customer or support site.
Country code associated with the case.
Primary language used in the case.
Contact channel used by the customer.
Short description of the specific issue or symptom.
Jonly product involved in the case.
Support level or queue that handled the case.
Total handle time for the case in seconds. Includes active handling time; generally between 180 and 3600 seconds.
Number of transfers during the case (hand-offs between agents, tiers, or queues). Higher values indicate more friction.
Resolution indicator (1 = resolved, 0 = unresolved) based on case outcome.
Customer satisfaction score for the case on a 1–5 scale, where 1 is very dissatisfied and 5 is very satisfied.
Derived sentiment score associated with the case interaction, normalized approximately between -1 (very negative) and 1 (very positive).
